data.comment:
# Comfy Kling 3.0- Text to Image

Generate an image from a text prompt using the Kling 3.0 model. Input your descriptive text to receive a high-quality, prompt-accurate visual output. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_kling_v3_t2i.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: A man in a beige suit, white shirt, and yellow tie stands against a clear blue sky, with a large, fluffy white cloud replacing his head, and a brown hat visible within the cloud.
